deep.surprise_reason: The folio is a printed newspaper page (Turin, July 1865) with no mathematical content and no Riemann annotations. Its only interest is biographical or archival: it fits Riemann's 1865 stay in Italy and how his papers were kept.
transcription_corrections: The machine transcription of the printed text is essentially accurate; there is no mathematical content to correct.

Not transcribed: a handwritten pencil folio number '98' in the right margin, level with the line 'del 4 luglio alle 4 del 5 luglio 1865' / 'Vianino Angela'. This is archival foliation, not Riemann's hand as far as can be judged.
The spellings 'Macchiavelli' and 'Parmà' are as printed in the original and are not transcription errors.
Small stray ink specks near the bottom centre of the page carry no content.
